interface.shortDescription: Build and run MTHDS methods on a runtime you run yourself.
interface.longDescription: Skills for the MTHDS open standard: build methods from scratch, validate their structure and semantics, run them on the Pipelex runtime on your machine or on your own pipelex-api server, and edit existing ones, with automatic .mthds file validation through a hook. For the easier route, with no runtime to install, use the Pipelex plugin from the Pipelex/pipelex-plugins marketplace.
defaultPrompt: Build an AI method that summarizes a PDF document

name: mthds
description: Skills for building, running, validating, and editing AI methods following the MTHDS standard, on a runtime you run yourself. For the easier, hosted route, install the Pipelex plugin from Pipelex/pipelex-plugins.
